summary: Remote WebSocket server drives a PTY shell and arbitrary filesystem operations on the installer's host
details: @yeaft/webchat-agent runs as a long-running daemon that connects outbound to a WebSocket server and dispatches server-sent messages to handlers that include terminal_input (writes bytes directly into a node-pty shell via term.pty.write), read_file / write_file / create_file / delete_files / move_files, git_* operations, execute (runs tool calls in workDir), restart_agent, and upgrade_agent. Whoever controls the configured WS endpoint obtains a full interactive shell and arbitrary filesystem/git control over the machine running the agent, gated only by agentSecret and a serverUrl taken from env/config. On startup the same process also performs an unpinned `git clone`/`git pull` of https://github.com/yeaft/yeaft-skills.git into ~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/yeaft-skills-dev, copies it into the plugins cache, chmods files under hooks/ to 0755, and writes the plugin into ~/.claude/settings.json enabledPlugins — so mutable HEAD content of that external repo becomes enabled Claude hook scripts on every start. service/linux.js additionally prepends ~/.local/bin and ~/.npm-global/bin to PATH via shell RC modification.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
